notes: All people, inventory, measurements and scenarios are fictional.
Research references motivate scope only; no measurements or thresholds were derived from NASA.
Scenario measurements and supplied baselines are independent fixtures, not joins to historical CSV.
CSV numeric empty cells mean unknown; convert to JSON null, never zero.
CSV reported_symptoms is a JSON array; usable is lowercase true/false.
Baselines are first seven daily records, arithmetic mean; not clinical normal ranges.
